title: Improvements and corrections from project use
summary: Implement and verify the five recorded planner improvements and UI corrections.
description:
Outcome: implement and verify the eight project-use improvements listed in docs/agent-brain/improvements-and-fixes.md, with one task per problem. T503 validates and extends decision-impact coverage using P128(F025)/T496. T504 delivers actionable initialization/discovery guidance on the foundations of P119(F025)/T468 and T469. T505 applies communication/conduct preferences through the existing guidance owner T468. T506 fixes structured search of empty features/phases; T507 collapses the project description accessibly. T508 returns a brief confirmation for successful description-only updates, adding dependency-change details only when relevant to the agent's current activity. Whether and how another affected agent in a different phase is notified remains open for implementation discussion; full diagnostics remain available on demand using T496. Do not duplicate core capabilities: each task consumes and extends its existing owner where applicable, preserving cross-harness operation, planner history and bounded context. Current UI inspection points: packages/plan-web-ui/src/hooks/use-dashboard-tree.ts:119, packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/search-bar.tsx:86 and packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/layout/app-shell.tsx:160; find current symbols before editing because locations change. Preserve the reviewed UI prototypes, existing search filters and project identity. Acceptance: each AB-IMP-001 through AB-IMP-008 has task-specific verification and evidence, with incomplete or unverified work explicit. This phase is ordered before P124 closeout; F025 and other phase priorities remain intact.

Two additional reports, AB-IMP-007 and AB-IMP-008, are recorded for discussion and task allocation: session-aware phase continuity versus global priority, and recommendation of planning for an eligible empty phase. Do not claim their proposed tasks are already registered; resolve scheduling precedence without silently changing existing decisions.

T509 addresses session-specific phase continuity after task completion; T510 adds an explicit phase-planning action for eligible empty phases. Both extend existing T462/T463 selection owners; T510 also consumes T465. Discuss and reconcile precedence between phase assignment, global priority and empty-phase planning before implementing; do not silently change the existing decision or create phase locks. See AB-IMP-007/008.

tasks.title: Review all affected task contracts after decision changes
tasks.description: AB-IMP-001. Outcome: complete and verify decision-change impact across a task's prerequisites, their consumers and downstream dependencies; phase/feature decisions seed all contained tasks. Existing P128(F025)/T496 owns shared impact reconciliation and durable pending obligations; extend/consume it, never build a second dependency authority. Inspect packages/plan-core/src/description-freshness.ts:1 and packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:1 before editing. Derive candidate IDs from old/new dependency edges and parent links; cover indirect and cross-feature consumers, changed/deleted edges, unchanged reviewed evidence and resumed work with current context. Preserve correctly completed history and existing warning/advisory policy; never auto-reopen tasks. Batch large fan-out without silently dropping affected tasks or rereading unrelated plan content. Acceptance: isolated change scenarios prove complete candidate/review coverage, durable pending obligations, accurate parent/requirement reconciliation and bounded payload/token use. Full contract: docs/agent-brain/improvements-and-fixes.md#AB-IMP-001.

tasks.title: Provide planner guidance and progressive discovery from initialization
tasks.description: AB-IMP-002. Outcome: an agent initializing a project receives useful portable planner guidance before project rules or descriptions exist; project discovery produces factual scope/requirements and can create features/phases without inventing tasks. P119(F025)/T468 owns canonical cross-harness skill delivery; T469 owns proportionate planning. Build on those contracts rather than duplicating the bootstrap. Inspect packages/plan-core/src/planner-skill.ts:1, packages/plan-core/planner-skill.md:1 and packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:1 before changes; coordinate Pi and shared API ownership. Do not write conversational placeholders or invented decisions into descriptions: preserve real uncertainty as actionable open questions. When preparing a feature/phase for execution, discuss tasks with grill-me; honor an explicit earlier user request. Support empty/non-Git folders and undecided languages. Acceptance: isolated MCP/Pi initialization yields useful guidance, factual descriptions and a feature/phase with zero tasks; later discovery creates appropriately discussed tasks without duplicate capability ownership. Full contract: docs/agent-brain/improvements-and-fixes.md#AB-IMP-002.

tasks.title: Configure and deliver communication and conduct preferences
tasks.description: AB-IMP-003. Outcome: project/user communication preferences cover brevity, explanation depth and formal/informal tone independently and are delivered consistently to agents. Reuse P119(F025)/T468 and canonical Project Guidelines; inspect packages/plan-core/src/planner-skill.ts:1 and packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts:1 before editing. Collect optional preferences during discovery, allow later changes, and respect explicit current user instructions followed by project and user defaults. Keep mandatory operating rules and permissions authoritative; do not falsely equate short replies with omitted facts or use style preferences to hide uncertainty. Deliver changed guidance after context loss across MCP/Pi without resending unchanged full project context unnecessarily. Acceptance: exercise concise, formal and explanatory profiles, explicit user override, preference change and context restoration with no lost required context or permission change. Full contract: docs/agent-brain/improvements-and-fixes.md#AB-IMP-003.

tasks.title: Find empty features and phases in structured search
tasks.description:
AB-IMP-004. Outcome: elastic-input search returns matching features and phases even with no child tasks. Current source: packages/plan-web-ui/src/hooks/use-dashboard-tree.ts:119 collects matching parent IDs within task iteration; packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/search-bar.tsx:86 builds title suggestions from task titles. Inspect these and packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/task-search.ts:1 and tree visibility rules before changes; paths and lines are navigation only. Support empty feature, phase without tasks and features with only empty phases by supported IDs/names and structured feature/phase queries. Preserve task results, filters, entity navigation and counts, and align suggestions with the supported results. Capture an isolated reproduction and verify search, selection, clearing, status filters and a task-bearing control branch. Use reviewed Agent Brain UI design and appropriate existing search owner. Full contract: docs/agent-brain/improvements-and-fixes.md#AB-IMP-004.

---
**Completion summary:**
Shipped: centralized the fix in the shared search library. task-search.ts now builds buildFeatureHay/buildPhaseHay as the entity haystacks composed into buildTaskHay, adds matchFeature/matchPhase sharing the feature/phase scope helpers with matchTask; task-scoped filters (task:/status:) never fabricate a parent match and phase-scoped filters match a parent only through a matching descendant phase. use-dashboard-tree.ts collects matched feature/phase ids independently of tasks and keeps matched empty branches visible with correct zero-task counts. search-bar.tsx title suggestions cover feature names and phase titles too. Files: packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/task-search.ts, packages/plan-web-ui/src/hooks/use-dashboard-tree.ts, packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/search-bar.tsx. Verification: 21 new cases in packages/plan-web-ui/test/task-search.test.mjs (34 pass) covering empty feature/phase by number, status, shortId, free text, cross-scope intersections and fabricated-match guards; plan-web-ui typecheck green; canonical pnpm verify:final gate green (build, typecheck, coverage, plugin sync, capability audit, browser E2E, packed-installation smoke). Shipped in release v0.4.11 via PR #86 (commits 44072c5, ca73947) merged to develop and PR #88 to main; AB-IMP-004 criteria exercised: structured feature/phase queries, name search, suggestions-vs-tree consistency, clear-query and status-filter regression. Remaining: none.

tasks.title: Collapse the project description in the Web UI
tasks.description:
AB-IMP-005. Outcome: the project description appears in an initially collapsed accordion, avoiding an oversized project header while keeping its complete formatted content available. Inspect packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/layout/app-shell.tsx:160 and existing accordion/accessibility patterns before implementation; the redesigned UI follows docs/agent-brain/ui-prototypes.md. Reuse suitable existing components, preserve the project name, formatting and project navigation, and avoid an empty control when description is absent. The user can expand/collapse by pointer and keyboard with appropriate accessibility semantics. Acceptance: verify a long formatted description starts collapsed, expands completely, collapses again and remains accessible via keyboard; verify empty descriptions and switching between projects. Full contract: docs/agent-brain/improvements-and-fixes.md#AB-IMP-005.

---
**Completion summary:**
Shipped: project description now renders in the canonical Accordion (packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/layout/app-shell.tsx) at full container width below the page header, collapsed by default, expandable/collapsible by pointer and keyboard via native details/summary semantics, and not rendered when the description is missing or empty. Project Goal is also a canonical Accordion (packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/dashboard/route.tsx) with the Edit action as an icon-only Button (aria-label preserved, shortcut still functional), auto-expanded when no goal exists so the add-a-goal hint stays visible; dashboard grid rhythm tightened gap-8 to gap-5. Supporting component ownership landed with it: Accordion owns its title (canonical h3), content typography (text-sm leading-6), chevron state (direct-child CSS rule fixing nested-accordion rotation) and carries no built-in margin; Project Context switched from Card + raw details to the canonical Accordion. Files: app-shell.tsx, dashboard/route.tsx, components/ui/accordion.tsx, components/ui/button.tsx, styles/base.css, components/dashboard/project-context.tsx. Verification: plan-web-ui suite 111/111 green including entity-references and disclosure-defaults suites; canonical pnpm verify:final gate green; released in v0.4.11 via PR #86 (commits 8197f4c, 153090c) and PR #88 to main. Remaining: none.

tasks.title: Bound planner mutation diagnostics to affected entities
tasks.description: AB-IMP-006. Outcome: updating a task or phase returns compact diagnostics scoped to the affected entities, without transmitting a project-wide list of unrelated freshness checks. Current source inspection: packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:1394 and :1829 call PlanStore.previewDescriptionReconciliation for description/descriptionRef updates, filter staleParentRefs to the owner chain, but put the complete descriptionFreshness result in mutation extras. packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:2149 loads the full workspace; packages/plan-core/src/description-freshness.ts:98 computes diagnostics across all phases and features; packages/plan-core/src/mutation-reply.ts:95 says extras are never trimmed. Inspect equivalent Pi adapter paths in packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:4531 and :5152 and the actual serialized content/structuredContent before changing anything. Line numbers are navigation hints, not stable identity. P128(F025)/T496 owns the common mutation-impact foundation and T503 owns semantic decision impact: reuse their indexing, durable pending obligations and parent/dependency semantics instead of adding another reconciliation authority. For a successful task/phase description-only update, return a brief confirmation of the persisted write and entity reference. If the change affects a dependency of the requesting agent's current activity, add only a concise relevant impact: changed dependency reference, what changed and why it affects that activity. Do not echo the description or include unrelated freshness diagnostics, project-wide checks, previews or pending lists in either output channel. Open design question for implementation discussion: a dependency change may affect another agent working in a different phase. Determine whether, when and how to notify that agent, including attribution, relevance, delivery/recovery, token cost, privacy and what happens when it is offline. Do not assume an existing event channel or make unsolicited notification a settled decision. If relevance cannot be determined, do not invent it: retain the obligation for explicit retrieval or the next context refresh. The confirmation proves persistence only, not semantic reconciliation. Preserve affected-parent/dependency checks and durable unresolved obligations in the owning reconciliation system; expose their details on explicit request with bounded continuation. Failed writes return errors. Preserve essential lifecycle notices, lost ticks and warnings for other operations, especially combined updates that have side effects. Keep a separate explicitly requested project-wide diagnostic for audit; do not silently truncate or mark unresolved work complete. Measure both backend work and complete MCP/Pi serialized response size including text/structured duplication on fixed equivalent fixtures while unrelated phases grow; ordinary local writes must not scale response payload with unrelated stale phases. Acceptance: isolated successful task and phase description-only updates on small and large projects return only a brief confirmation when no current-activity dependency is affected, and add only relevant dependency-change details when it is; the cross-agent/different-phase notification scenarios are evaluated against the design agreed during implementation; no description echo or unrelated freshness payload appears in either output channel; failed writes return errors; non-description and combined changes retain their existing essential notices, and explicit scoped/full diagnostics retain correct behavior; required warnings and real affected dependencies remain available; report measured before/after bytes/tokens and runtime without hard-coded unsupported token claims. Keep API compatibility or explicitly document the transition. The issue is agent-reported and source-inspected; reproduce it with isolated fixtures before changing behavior. Full contract: docs/agent-brain/improvements-and-fixes.md#AB-IMP-006.

tasks.title: Preserve session-specific phase continuity in next-work recommendations
tasks.description: AB-IMP-007. Outcome: next-work recommendations after task completion use the requesting session and its assigned/current phase, without sending an agent into another agent's phase because an unrelated task ranks higher. Reproduce the reported case on isolated fixtures: dev-1 works P001/T001–T003; dev-2 works P002/T004–T006; after dev-2 finishes T004, explain and recommend eligible T005 rather than T002. Current source: packages/plan-core/src/task-selection.ts:283 already accepts currentPhaseId/sessionId; packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:1978 passes plannerSessionId and focus. Inspect current implementations, installed runtime, completion/recap/MCP/Pi/CLI paths and the persisted caller/session identity before attributing the cause; file:line is a navigation hint. Reuse P116(F025)/T462 and P117(F025)/T463 as the single selection contract/owner; do not build another scheduler or global task queue. Open decision to discuss before implementation: precedence between current/assigned phase continuity and global feature -> phase -> task priority, assignment lifetime, blocked/empty/completed phase, missing/ambiguous session, explicit user-approved deviation and pending return. The reported intended behavior is phase continuity for dev-2; do not silently change the existing accepted global-priority rule until the conflict is resolved. Preserve independent task ownership and the execution lock; phase continuity is not an exclusive phase lock and a recommendation is not a reservation. Acceptance: reproduce the exact two-session completion scenario on all supported surfaces; verify no cross-session focus leakage, no takeover of another session's active task, truthful exclusions and recovery after restart/context loss. Verify agreed precedence and a blocked/completed phase, and keep bounded response/context costs. Detailed report: docs/agent-brain/improvements-and-fixes.md#AB-IMP-007.

tasks.title: Recommend planning for eligible empty phases
tasks.description: AB-IMP-008. Outcome: when an eligible higher-priority phase has no tasks and awaits planning, the next-work workflow can recommend a phase-level discuss/prepare action rather than silently skipping to lower-priority task work. Reproduce P001 priority 1 with zero tasks and P002 priority 2 with ready tasks on isolated fixtures. Inspect packages/plan-core/src/task-selection.ts:401, packages/plan-core/src/recap.ts:1, packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:1978 and the Pi/CLI/UI consumers; file:line is a navigation hint. Reuse the shared selection contract and implementation P116(F025)/T462, P117(F025)/T463 and resume projection P118(F025)/T465; represent a phase-planning action distinctly from a real task recommendation. Do not fabricate a placeholder task, modify status or create tasks implicitly. Open decisions to discuss before implementation: how to identify awaiting-planning versus intentionally empty/resolved or blocked phases, when that action outranks ready tasks, and how it interacts with session-assigned phase continuity, returns and global priority. Acceptance: surface the agreed action for P001, with phase identity and reason; handle several sessions, explicit exclusion/intentional emptiness, blocked phases and phases with terminal tasks; no recurring suggestion after preparation is deliberately resolved and no silent task creation. Preserve advisory scheduling and current execution-lock semantics. Detailed report: docs/agent-brain/improvements-and-fixes.md#AB-IMP-008.
